app.title: Maiao: Gerrit-style code review workflow for GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, others
app.author: zdw
app.description: CLI and web UI for a Gerrit-style code review workflow that works across GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, and other Git hosts.
proposed_tests: Measure CLI latency for creating a review and listing reviews
